rules.label: If you capture a tagged fish, do not allow the tag to influence your decision to kill or release the fish. If you had intended to release the fish prior to seeing the tag, do so. If you had intended to keep the fish as part of your quota prior to seeing the tag, do so. In either circumstance, record the tag number, tag colour, species, location, and date of capture. If you are releasing the fish, do not remove the tag.
